systems.system: E-Government Project (e-government network, government intranet; also the Broadband Project)
systems.country_label: E-government network / government intranet; administrative intranet
systems.platform: Huawei and China Machinery Engineering Corporation (phase 1); Huawei (phase 2)
systems.owner: Government of Senegal; China Eximbank concessional loans of RMB 390 million (2007), US$50 million (2012) and RMB 530 million (24 November 2015)
systems.tiers: Phase 1 (2007-2009): 500 km of fibre in Dakar, Thiès, Louga, Saint-Louis, Diourbel, Kaolack and Fatick for government agencies, universities, hospitals and state enterprises, with telephony in 11 regional capitals. Phase 2 (December 2012 to late 2014): 1,000 km more to 16 named towns and the AIBD airport. No commune or town hall is said to be on it

note: A loan record for the government fibre network and intranet: it names government agencies, universities and hospitals as users and regional capitals as the reach, and puts no local government office on the network.
